title: Reading Drill — Comparing objects found on beaches — Reviewing the evidence
description: One short passage, six questions. Recommended time: 10 minutes.

passages.title: Comparing objects found on beaches — Reviewing the evidence
passages.body:
**A** The beach survey team in Hillswick received an old report about small pieces being counted more often on smoother sections. The report compared objects seen per survey strip, but some entries had been collected under different conditions. To check the report, reviewers returned to the measuring tapes rather than treating the published figures as a complete record.

**B** The review covered seven weeks. In the first part of that period, the original records did not consistently include the height of the last tide. In the later part, the recording sheet included a separate field for it. The reviewers kept readings from both periods, but marked which items were missing rather than guessing what had happened.

**C** The conclusion listed a consistent sampling strip as a possible later response. It recommended collecting another set of readings before deciding whether to use it. The new data would be published with the method, so another group could work out whether its own measurements were comparable.
